title: Tactile 0.50 多指手势灵敏度全面升级与现代 macOS 14+ 深度适配

notes.zh:
Tactile 0.50 重点更新：
• 多指清扫手势（二指/三指/四指/五指左右与上下清扫）灵敏度全面提升：大幅降低直线轨迹严苛度要求，支持带弧度与斜向自然滑动，响应速度与识别率显著提升
• 捏合手势（二指/三指/四指/五指捏合与张开）算法升级：增强中心点收敛与发散容差，微小手势即可顺畅触发
• 触控板平滑度与抗抖动升级：优化多指触控轨迹追踪平滑窗口，彻底解决四指左右轻扫识别严苛与偶发漏识别问题
• macOS 14+ 现代 API 深度合规：彻底移除废弃的 activate(ignoringOtherApps:)，全链路采用 macOS 14/15 官方标准 NSApp.activate() 激活，零控制台警告与更高稳定性
• 包含 Apple Silicon (arm64) 与 Intel (x86_64) 原生独立版及 Universal 2 通用二进制，均通过 Developer ID 权威签名
notes.en:
Tactile 0.50 Highlights:
• Multitouch swipe sensitivity overhaul: comprehensive sensitivity boost for 2, 3, 4, and 5-finger directional swipes with relaxed trajectory linearity tolerance, making natural curved swipes effortlessly recognized
• Pinch gesture algorithm upgrade: enhanced convergence/divergence detection for 2, 3, 4, and 5-finger pinch in/out gestures with subtle movement triggering
• Dynamic gesture tracking smoothing: optimized multitouch smoothing window to eliminate missed or strict 4-finger swipe triggers
• Modern macOS 14+ API compliance: replaced legacy activate(ignoringOtherApps:) with modern NSApp.activate(), eliminating system deprecation warnings
• Built & notarized with Developer ID as Universal 2, Apple Silicon, and Intel standalone packages
